dialogues.jp:
商店街で田端や工藤とブラブラしているうちに、
あっという間に金が尽きてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I spent all of my money while hanging around with my friends
at the promenade.
dialogues.text:
I spent all of my money while hanging around with my friends
at the promenade.

dialogues.jp: 「遊んだ遊んだ……さって、そろそろ帰るかな」
dialogues.en: "That was fun...... but it's time to go home."
dialogues.text: "That was fun...... but it's time to go home."

dialogues.jp:
もう遅い。そろそろ音夢も心配するかも知れな
いし、テスト前の開放感にも区切れをつけるべ
きだろう。
dialogues.en:
It was getting late. Nemu might be getting worried, and I
should also be studying for the exam.
dialogues.text:
It was getting late. Nemu might be getting worried, and I
should also be studying for the exam.

dialogues.jp: 「すぐに春なんだなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Spring's near."
dialogues.text: "Spring's near."

dialogues.speaker: A mysterious voice
dialogues.jp: 「わたしは夏のほうが好きだけどね〜」
dialogues.en: "I like summer better."
dialogues.text: "I like summer better."

dialogues.jp:
明らかに俺の言葉に続けたとしか思えない声に、
ゆっくりと振り返る。
dialogues.en: I turned around slowly to see where the voice came from.
dialogues.text: I turned around slowly to see where the voice came from.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう――じゃなかった、こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Good morning... I mean, good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "Good morning... I mean, good afternoon."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon."

dialogues.jp:
帽子をかぶったお嬢様然とした少女が立ってい
た。
dialogues.en: There was a girl in a hat standing there.
dialogues.text: There was a girl in a hat standing there.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp:
「凄いですねココは。こんなにお店があって！
　コンビニもたくさん♪」
dialogues.en:
"This place is great. There are so many stores! ...Even many
convenience stores!"
dialogues.text:
"This place is great. There are so many stores! ...Even many
convenience stores!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「たくさん？」
dialogues.en: "Many?"
dialogues.text: "Many?"

dialogues.jp: 見渡す限りには２軒ほどしかないが。
dialogues.en: I can only see two of them.
dialogues.text: I can only see two of them.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp:
「だから、コンビニを目印に待ち合わせをした
　ら道に迷ってしまって」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I'm lost, as I was supposed to meet someone at
the convenience store."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I'm lost, as I was supposed to meet someone at
the convenience store."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「えと……迷子なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Um...... are you lost?"
dialogues.text: "Um...... are you lost?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「道に迷ってしまって」
dialogues.en: "I lost my way."
dialogues.text: "I lost my way."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「だから迷子――」
dialogues.en: "So you're lost..."
dialogues.text: "So you're lost..."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「道に迷ったんですぅ！」
dialogues.en: "I just lost my way!"
dialogues.text: "I just lost my way!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ、道に迷ったということで」
dialogues.en: "......Okay, so you lost your way."
dialogues.text: "......Okay, so you lost your way."

dialogues.jp:
意味は同じだと思うのだが、帽子の少女はニッ
コリと笑って小首をかしげる。
dialogues.en:
I think they both have the same meaning, but the girl
insisted with a tilt of her head and a smile.
dialogues.text:
I think they both have the same meaning, but the girl
insisted with a tilt of her head and a smile.

dialogues.jp:
なんと言うのか、勝ち目のない笑い方だと思っ
た。
dialogues.en: I don't know how to describe it, but it was a perfect smile.
dialogues.text: I don't know how to describe it, but it was a perfect smile.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp:
「こんなに道が枝分かれしてると、あみだくじ
　みたいで面白いですよね？」
dialogues.en:
"It's fun to have so many streets like this, it's like a
maze."
dialogues.text:
"It's fun to have so many streets like this, it's like a
maze."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですね」

なんとなく、この人が道に迷う理由が分かる気
がする。
dialogues.en: I can kind of see why this girl gets lost.
dialogues.text: I can kind of see why this girl gets lost.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp:
「で、道を教えて欲しいんですけど。ここに地
　図があって」
dialogues.en: "So, I'd like to ask for directions. I have a map here."
dialogues.text: "So, I'd like to ask for directions. I have a map here."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「はい……おぉ！」
dialogues.en: "Yes......Wow!"
dialogues.text: "Yes......Wow!"

dialogues.jp:
少女から渡された地図は、手書きなのだが市販
の物と変わらない緻密さで、しかも細かい注釈
までついていた。
dialogues.en:
The map she handed to me was hand written but with as much
detail as a regular map, and it even had some notes.
dialogues.text:
The map she handed to me was hand written but with as much
detail as a regular map, and it even had some notes.

dialogues.jp: （しかし、なんだこれ？）
dialogues.en: (What's this?)
dialogues.text: (What's this?)

dialogues.jp:
紙の端に、買い食いしない、寄り道しない、車
に気をつける――など、子供のお使いレベルの
注意が記されている。
dialogues.en:
There were things written on the edge of the map like -- no
snacking, no making extra stops, be careful with cars.
dialogues.text:
There were things written on the edge of the map like -- no
snacking, no making extra stops, be careful with cars.

dialogues.jp: この人は、どんな田舎から出てきた人なんだ？
dialogues.en: Is she from the countryside?
dialogues.text: Is she from the countryside?

dialogues.jp:
見た目は掛け値なしの美人だし、本当の箱入り
娘のお嬢様なのかも知れない。
dialogues.en: She's very beautiful, and seems to be from a wealthy family.
dialogues.text: She's very beautiful, and seems to be from a wealthy family.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「この地図、見づらいですよね？」
dialogues.en: "This map's hard to read, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "This map's hard to read, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp:
「いや……ほとんどこの通りでいいんですけ
　ど？」
dialogues.en: "Not really...... it looks pretty good to me."
dialogues.text: "Not really...... it looks pretty good to me."

dialogues.jp: 教えるべきこともないレベルだ。
dialogues.en: Nothing much to add.
dialogues.text: Nothing much to add.

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp:
「文字で書かれるより、その場の風景とか看板
　のほうがいいんだけど……蒼司くんも意地悪
　なんだから」
dialogues.en:
"It's easier to read if there are descriptions of the views
and signs...... Soji-kun isn't very kind."
dialogues.text:
"It's easier to read if there are descriptions of the views
and signs...... Soji-kun isn't very kind."

dialogues.jp:
この場に居ない人間への愚痴をこぼされても、
拾うことは出来ない。
dialogues.en:
I can't agree with her and complain about someone who isn't
here.
dialogues.text:
I can't agree with her and complain about someone who isn't
here.

dialogues.jp:
案内するしかないか――と思いかけた時、パッ
と少女の顔つきが明るく変わった。
dialogues.en:
I was thinking of escorting her to the meeting place by
myself... and at that moment, her face lit up.
dialogues.text:
I was thinking of escorting her to the meeting place by
myself... and at that moment, her face lit up.

dialogues.speaker: Boyfriend?
dialogues.jp: 「さやか先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Sayaka-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Sayaka-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「蒼司く〜ん」
dialogues.en: "Soji-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Soji-kun!"

dialogues.jp:
人が変わったかと思うほど、恐ろしく子供っぽ
くなって手を振る少女。
dialogues.en:
Her voice changed to a very childish voice, and she waved at
the guy.
dialogues.text:
Her voice changed to a very childish voice, and she waved at
the guy.

dialogues.speaker: Boyfriend?
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり道に迷ってたんですね？」
dialogues.en: "I thought you must be lost."
dialogues.text: "I thought you must be lost."

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「地図分かり辛いよ〜、よよよ」
dialogues.en: "Your map was hard to read."
dialogues.text: "Your map was hard to read."

dialogues.speaker: Boyfriend?
dialogues.jp: 「……買い食いしましたね？」
dialogues.en: "......Did you snack on the way?"
dialogues.text: "......Did you snack on the way?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「う……あははははは♪」
dialogues.en: "Um......hahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Um......hahaha!"

dialogues.jp: とても分かりやすい笑い方だ。
dialogues.en: It was very easy to tell from her answer.
dialogues.text: It was very easy to tell from her answer.

dialogues.speaker: Boyfriend?
dialogues.jp: 「どうも連れがご迷惑をおかけしました」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry for the trouble."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry for the trouble."

dialogues.jp: と、後から来た蒼司という少年が頭を下げる。
dialogues.en: The guy apologized at me.
dialogues.text: The guy apologized at me.

dialogues.jp: 「いえ、特になにもしてませんから」
dialogues.en: "It was no trouble."
dialogues.text: "It was no trouble."

dialogues.jp: 妙な礼儀正しさに慌ててしまう。
dialogues.en: I got nervous with his politeness.
dialogues.text: I got nervous with his politeness.

dialogues.jp:
少年は、俺よりも少し年上といったところだろ
うが、これが大人なんだと分かる物腰だ。
dialogues.en: He looked a little older than me, but acted like an adult.
dialogues.text: He looked a little older than me, but acted like an adult.

dialogues.speaker: Boyfriend?
dialogues.jp: 「では。先輩行きますよ」
dialogues.en: "Shall we go?"
dialogues.text: "Shall we go?"

dialogues.speaker: Girl with hat
dialogues.jp: 「は〜い。ばいび〜♪」
dialogues.en: "Okay. Bye!"
dialogues.text: "Okay. Bye!"

dialogues.speaker: Boyfriend?
dialogues.jp:
「ありがとうございました……先輩、挨拶はさ
　ようならです」
dialogues.en:
"Thank you very much for your help...... Sempai, please
thank him properly."
dialogues.text:
"Thank you very much for your help...... Sempai, please
thank him properly."

dialogues.jp:
ふたりは痴話喧嘩しながらも、お互いを知り尽
くしたような雰囲気で道を去っていく。
dialogues.en: They were talking to each other just like a married couple.
dialogues.text: They were talking to each other just like a married couple.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだったんだ一体……」
dialogues.en: "What was that......?"
dialogues.text: "What was that......?"

dialogues.jp:
取り残された俺は、とても騒がしい馬鹿ップル
の背中を見送りながら、カラスの鳴き声を聞い
ていた。
dialogues.en:
I watched the silly couple disappear and listened to the
crows.
dialogues.text:
I watched the silly couple disappear and listened to the
crows.

dialogues.jp: ◆謎の馬鹿ップル◆
dialogues.en: ◆Unknown silly couple◆
dialogues.text: ◆Unknown silly couple◆

dialogues.jp: 謎のバカップルに出会ってしまった。
dialogues.en: I encountered an unknown silly couple.
dialogues.text: I encountered an unknown silly couple.

dialogues.jp:
女の人の方は迷子に──本人は、この呼称をか
たくなに否定していたが──なっていたらしい。
彼氏が見つけて、事なきを得たのだが。
dialogues.en:
The girl was lost --although she insisted that she wasn't
lost-- Her boyfriend showed up to find her in time.
dialogues.text:
The girl was lost --although she insisted that she wasn't
lost-- Her boyfriend showed up to find her in time.
